Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Ian Modern Wood Dining Kitchen Chairs, 33 Inch Height, Set of 2, Grey
Colors: Gray
Materials: Wood
Hints of mid-century, including sloping armless sides and a tall curved back, combine with traditional fabric for a transitional style that will blend with a variety of décor. Quality materials and construction make this chair sturdy and stable. 19"W x 24"D x 33"H; Seat Height: 18"H ; Seat Depth: 18"D; Seat Back Height: 15.25"H Sturdy hardwood frame and legs with performance fabric Assemble in 30 minutes or less; just bolt on legs Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
